## [0.2.0](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/icons/compare/v0.1.3...v0.2.0) (2020-06-30)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* This commit removes the concept of libraries from this repository. Anything to do with LD2 has been removed, and all LD3 content has been made the default. All scripts were updated to remove any references to library-based functionality. The export scripts have been removed.

A future commit will make a version of this structure available with the LD2 content in a separate branch.
